title: Testing Model-Collapse Diagnostics in Small-Scale Bangla–English Self-Training (release package)
description: Release package for the pre-registered study: experiment harness, configuration files, pre-registration and gate/decision records, per-generation metric records and per-item score records, analysis outputs including dated post-hoc analyses (the post-hoc seed replicates and the three-seed cross-decoder evaluation of 24 October 2026 included), and 50-document sample files (model-written contact details redacted) for an iterative self-training experiment with Gemma-3-270m in Bangla and English with pre-registered controls. Code is released under MIT; data, records and documents under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA). Restricted files can be requested under ACCESS.md. Pre-registration: OSF, DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/SRA28. BanStereoSet items are not redistributed; CrowS-Pairs is CC BY-SA 4.0.
